title: Chapter 1: Naming What You Feel
sub: Move past 'good' and 'bad' with sharper words.

cards.def: Having or showing a feeling of vague or regretful longing.
examples: She felt wistful looking at old photos from summer camp.
My grandmother grew wistful talking about her village.
He gave a wistful smile as the train left the station.
Old songs always make me feel a little wistful.
He was elated after getting the acceptance letter.
The whole family was elated when my sister got the job.
Fans were elated after India won the match.
She felt elated when her first article was published.

cards.def: In a state of peaceful happiness.
examples: He seemed content just sitting on the porch with his coffee.
My father is content with a simple life in our hometown.
The baby looked content after her afternoon nap.
I'm content with my salary as long as the work is interesting.

cards.def: A sentimental longing for the past.
examples: The song made him nostalgic for his college years.
Walking past my old school made me nostalgic.
The office reunion left everyone feeling nostalgic.
Rain and hot pakoras make me nostalgic for childhood.
